verdict.rationale: Featurebase collects feedback posts and puts them on a public roadmap with status changes, and it notifies requesters when items ship (featurebase-docs-15, featurebase-docs-19, featurebase-docs-12). That implies feedback can become tracked roadmap work. Turning a submission into a task in another system relies on generic integrations or custom webhooks (featurebase-docs-4, featurebase-docs-1), with no documented one-click conversion. Missing for 10: an explicit documented feature for converting a feedback post into a task or project, named task-tracker integrations (e.g., Jira or Linear) with linking behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
